disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码、打包产物、测试与文档中是否出现 API Key、口令、私钥、云凭据等密钥字样，以及读取宿主凭据文件、ssh 私钥、云凭据目录等敏感路径的逻辑，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code, build artifacts, tests, and documentation for API keys, passwords, private keys, cloud credentials, and other secret-like strings, as well as logic that reads host credential files, ssh private keys, cloud credential directories, and other sensitive paths; 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码（宿主导入文件与浏览器端包）只读写插件自己的设置命名空间（状态提示词），没有任何读取环境变量、宿主凭据或浏览器存储的逻辑。
checked_items.en: Runtime code (host import file and browser-side package) only reads and writes the plugin's own settings namespace (status prompt), with no logic to read environment variables, host credentials, or browser storage.

evidence.zh: 未检出读取宿主凭据文件或任何敏感路径的代码路径；运行时代码无凭据访问面，凭据外泄无网络闸场景在本插件不可达。
evidence.en: No code paths reading host credential files or any sensitive paths were detected; runtime code has no credential access surface, and the network-exfil-without-gate scenario is unreachable in this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 本插件不注册任何工具，也没有向模型上下文注入系统提示或工具描述的代码面；对全部文档、说明与代码注释做了注入措辞审查（指令覆写、系统消息伪装、诱导安装、优先级操纵等），命中 0。
checked_items.en: This plugin registers no tools and has no code surface that injects system prompts or tool descriptions into the model context; injection-wording review (instruction override, system message spoofing, install enticement, priority manipulation, etc.) of all documentation, descriptions, and code comments yielded 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 仓库内不存在模型面指令文件（代理指令、技能文件等）；浏览器端注入页面的可见文本仅为折叠摘要行与用户可配置的状态提示词，属正常 UI 文案。
checked_items.en: No model-facing instruction files (agent instructions, skill files, etc.) exist in the repository; the only visible text injected into the browser page's fold is the summary line and the user-configurable status prompt, which are normal UI copy.

evidence.zh: 未注册工具、无工具描述文本进入模型请求；唯一可配置文本是用户自己填写的状态提示词，不存在描述投毒面。
evidence.en: No tools registered, no tool description text enters model requests; the only configurable text is the status prompt that the user fills in themselves, so no description-poisoning surface exists.

evidence.zh: 没有任何工具描述或文案诱导模型执行安装、改写配置或放开权限；安装说明只出现在开发者文档中，属正常使用指引。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or copy induce the model to execute installs, modify configurations, or lift permissions; installation instructions appear only in developer documentation and are normal usage guidance.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码（src/ 目录与打包产物 lib/）未发现动态执行、危险函数或子进程调用，命中 0。
checked_items.en: Runtime code (src/ directory and build artifact lib/) shows no dynamic execution, dangerous functions, or subprocess calls; 0 hits.

checked_items.zh: 机器预扫命中 13 条，逐条核查均确认良性：执行类信号（DSH-X03/DG-R3-55）中 8 处位于 test/ 下测试脚本，都是把构建好的客户端包动态加载进假 DOM 测试环境做回归验证（test/fold-behavior.test.mjs:29、test/fold-regression.test.mjs:47、test/fold-reconcile.test.mjs:29、test/fold-animation.test.mjs:37、test/adversarial-race.mjs:74、test/adversarial-session.mjs:71、test/_flash.mjs:9），1 处是测试总入口用子进程逐个运行测试（test/run-all.mjs:1），另有 1 处在开发期部署脚本里用于构建与重启本机 DSH 服务（deploy.mjs:5）；这些脚本均不随 npm 包发布（发布清单只含 lib/ 与挂载补丁）。
checked_items.en: Machine pre-scan found 13 hits; each was reviewed and confirmed benign: among execution-type signals (DSH-X03/DG-R3-55), 8 are test scripts under test/, dynamically loading the built client package into a fake DOM test environment for regression verification (test/fold-behavior.test.mjs:29, test/fold-regression.test.mjs:47, test/fold-reconcile.test.mjs:29, test/fold-animation.test.mjs:37, test/adversarial-race.mjs:74, test/adversarial-session.mjs:71, test/_flash.mjs:9); 1 is a test entry point that runs tests individually via subprocess (test/run-all.mjs:1); another 1 is in a development-stage deployment script for building and restarting the local DSH service (deploy.mjs:5); none of these scripts are shipped with the npm package (the publish manifest contains only lib/ and the patch).

checked_items.zh: 混淆密度类信号（DSH-X08/DG-R3-60）3 条均为误报：两处超长行是命令图标 SVG 路径数据（src/fold.ts:1481、lib/client.js:1221），一处高转义密度是构建器把中文注释转义成 Unicode 后的 CSS 注释（lib/client.js:68），均无可执行含义。
checked_items.en: All 3 obfuscation-density signals (DSH-X08/DG-R3-60) are false positives: two overlong lines are SVG path data for command icons (src/fold.ts:1481, lib/client.js:1221), and one high-escape-density entry is a CSS comment where the build tool escaped Chinese comments into Unicode (lib/client.js:68); none carry executable meaning.

checked_items.zh: 树内执行载体信号（DSH-X07/DG-R3-59）1 条为 .github/workflows/ci.yml，内容是标准检查流水线（安装依赖、跑类型检查与测试），权限最小化，无外联、无密钥操作。
checked_items.en: The 1 in-tree executable carrier signal (DSH-X07/DG-R3-59) is .github/workflows/ci.yml, whose content is a standard check pipeline (install dependencies, run type checks and tests) with least-privilege permissions, no outbound connections, and no secret operations.

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁 cordis.patch.yml 仅插入插件自身节点，不含任何可执行标量（DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 未命中）；package.json 无安装钩子脚本（DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 未命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch cordis.patch.yml only inserts the plugin's own node and contains no executable scalars (DSH-P01/DG-R3-51 not hit); package.json has no install hook script (DSH-X02/DG-R3-54 not hit).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁文件只做节点插入，不含任何可执行标量（如动态 JS 表达式），不存在经配置执行代码的路径。
evidence.en: The patch file only does node insertion, containing no executable scalars (e.g., dynamic JS expressions); there is no path for executing code via configuration.

evidence.zh: 未调用任何动态包执行工具（DSH-X01/DG-R3-53 未命中），无把模型代码塞进宿主进程执行的接口。
evidence.en: No dynamic package execution tool is invoked (DSH-X01/DG-R3-53 not hit), and there is no interface to shove model code into the host process for execution.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装钩子；仓库内无 git 钩子、容器配置、Makefile 等执行载体，仅标准 CI 工作流且内容为常规检查。
evidence.en: package.json has no install hook; the repository contains no git hooks, container configuration, Makefile, or other execution carriers, aside from the standard CI workflow whose content is routine checks.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端入口（dsh.client），已做专项检查：无键盘监听、无剪贴板读取、无凭据接口调用、无可疑外联（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 未命中），仅做文档结构观察与折叠操作。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side entry (dsh.client) and received a dedicated review: no keyboard listener, no clipboard read, no credential interface calls, no suspicious outbound connections (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 not hit); it only observes DOM structure and performs folding operations.

checked_items.zh: 运行时代码中不存在任何网络请求、WebSocket、DNS 查询或数据发送逻辑，外联域名清单为空；浏览器端包与宿主导入文件均无网络面（DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Runtime code contains no network requests, WebSocket, DNS lookups, or data-sending logic; the outbound domain list is empty; both the browser-side package and host import file have no network surface (DSH-C03/DG-R4-51 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 唯一的网络访问位于开发期部署脚本 deploy.mjs，且仅访问本机 127.0.0.1 用于验证部署结果，不随 npm 包发布，不构成运行时外联。
checked_items.en: The only network access is in the development-stage deployment script deploy.mjs, and it only accesses local 127.0.0.1 to verify deployment results; it is not shipped with the npm package and does not constitute runtime outbound communication.

evidence.zh: 运行时代码无任何外联通道，凭据外泄无网络闸场景在运行时不可达；部署脚本的本机访问属开发期工具。
evidence.en: Runtime code has no outbound channel, making the credential-exfiltration-without-network-gate scenario unreachable at runtime; the deployment script's local access is a development-stage tool.

checked_items.zh: 依赖清单核对：仅开发依赖构建器与类型检查器，peer 依赖为宿主官方设置库与 schema 库；lock 文件锁定精确版本并带完整性哈希；未发现名称仿冒、私有命名撞车或未锁定 git 依赖（DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 未命中）。
checked_items.en: Dependency manifest review: only dev dependencies for the build tool and type checker, peer dependencies are the host's official settings library and schema library; the lock file pins exact versions with integrity hashes; no name impersonation, private namespace collisions, or unpinned git dependencies were found (DSH-S04/DG-R5-56 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子与树内执行载体检查：package.json 无安装钩子，仓库内无 git 钩子、容器配置、Makefile 等（除标准 CI 工作流，DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 已核查为良性）。
checked_items.en: Install hook and in-tree executable carrier checks: package.json has no install hook, and the repository has no git hooks, container configuration, Makefile, etc. (except the standard CI workflow, DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 already verified benign).

checked_items.zh: 挂载补丁不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，无禁用或环境变量降权写法（DSH-P03/DG-R5-51、DSH-P04/DG-R5-52 未命中），未改写注入/拦截配置（DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 未命中），未发现对安全事件的高优监听截断审批链（DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 未命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration lines; there is no disabling or environment-variable downgrade style (DSH-P03/DG-R5-51, DSH-P04/DG-R5-52 not hit), no rewriting of injection/interception configuration (DSH-P05/DG-R5-53 not hit), and no high-priority listener on security events that could truncate the approval chain (DSH-S01/DG-R5-54 not hit).

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无版本基线，无法做版本间清单突变比对（DSH-S02/DG-R5-55 不适用）。
checked_items.en: First audit, no version baseline, so cross-version manifest mutation comparison cannot be performed (DSH-S02/DG-R5-55 not applicable).

evidence.zh: 挂载补丁仅插入插件节点，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也无禁用或降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch only inserts plugin nodes, does not touch sandbox, approval, permission, or other security configuration lines, and contains no disabling or downgrade style.

evidence.zh: 未发现对安全事件的高优监听，不存在截断审批链的面。
evidence.en: No high-priority listeners on security events were found; there is no surface to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计，无上一版本基线可供比对升级自动激活与清单突变。
evidence.en: First-version audit, no previous version baseline to compare for upgrade auto-activation and manifest mutations.

evidence.zh: 补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的面。
evidence.en: The patch does not rewrite injection/interception configuration, and there is no surface to append a required service to a security plugin that would cause it to hang.

checked_items.zh: 插件不启动任何网络服务或监听端口，不引入本机无认证 RPC 面（DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 未命中）；运行时为浏览器端 DOM 操作与宿主设置读写。
checked_items.en: The plugin starts no network services or listening ports and introduces no local unauthenticated RPC surface (DSH-S03/DG-R6-51 not hit); at runtime it is browser-side DOM operations and host settings reads/writes.

checked_items.zh: 客户端逻辑通过文档观察器与动画帧驱动，卸载时完整还原所有折叠与改写；动态沙箱未启用，未做运行时行为观测，兼容性按未测试处理。
checked_items.en: Client logic is driven by a DOM observer and animation frames; on unload it fully restores all folds and rewrites; dynamic sandbox was not enabled, no runtime behavior observation was performed, and compatibility is treated as untested.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 web 服务、不监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin starts no web service and listens on no ports; the local unauthenticated RPC scenario is not applicable.

summary.zh: 插件声明与打包形态核对一致（dsh.bundle 补丁 + dsh.client 浏览器端），名称无仿冒迹象。
summary.en: The plugin's declarations and packaging form match (dsh.bundle patch + dsh.client browser side), with no name impersonation indications.

summary.zh: 静态扫描 33 条规则预扫命中 13 条，逐条核查全部确认为良性（测试桩、开发脚本、图标数据、标准 CI）。
summary.en: Static scan with 33 rules pre-scanned 13 hits; each hit was individually reviewed and confirmed benign (test stubs, dev scripts, icon data, standard CI).

summary.zh: 行为分析未发现安装钩子、混淆载荷、凭据读取或外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis found no install hooks, obfuscated payloads, credential reads, or outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查：无工具注册与系统提示注入面，文档与代码无注入措辞，能力声明与实测一致。
summary.en: AI metadata review: no tool registration or system prompt injection surface, no injection wording in docs and code, and capability declarations match measured behavior.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文未提供沙箱产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no sandbox artifacts were provided in the context).

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（上下文未提供沙箱产物），运行时行为仅靠静态与语义审查；插件未声明 dsh 引擎版本范围，兼容性按未测试处理；首版审计无版本基线可比对。适用性判定：package.json 含 dsh.bundle 与 dsh.client 声明、存在挂载补丁文件 cordis.patch.yml，确认属于 dsh 插件。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no sandbox artifacts provided in the context), so runtime behavior relies only on static and semantic review; the plugin does not declare a dsh engine version range, so compatibility is treated as untested; first-version audit has no version baseline for comparison. Applicability determination: package.json contains dsh.bundle and dsh.client declarations, and the patch file cordis.patch.yml exists, confirming it is a dsh plugin.
